name: Switch
description: The Switch component provides a toggle control that allows users to switch between two states (on/off).
usage: Three size options: small, medium, and large
examples:
<Switch id="small-switch" checked={checked} onChange={handleChange} size="sm" label="Small" />
<Switch id="medium-switch" checked={checked} onChange={handleChange} size="md" label="Medium" />
<Switch id="large-switch" checked={checked} onChange={handleChange} size="lg" label="Large" />

<Switch
  id="disabled-switch"
  checked={true}
  onChange={() => {}}
  disabled={true}
  label="Disabled switch"
/>
accessibility: Uses a standard checkbox input (visually hidden) for native keyboard navigation
Labels are properly associated with inputs

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback when the switch state changes (required)
